build_causal_lm_model: build a Jais2ForCausalLM model from a Jais2Config for autoregressive text generation
initialize_jais2_model: initialize a Jais2Model with Jais2Config to create the base transformer encoder stack
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on Jais2Model with input_ids and attention_mask to get hidden states
generate_text: generate text from Jais2ForCausalLM using model.generate with a tokenizer prompt input
train_with_labels: train Jais2ForCausalLM by passing input_ids and labels through forward for loss computation
